standard.title: Mettre (Present Tense — Irregular Verb)
standard.explanation: Mettre means 'to put' or 'to put on'. It is an irregular verb. In the present tense: je mets, tu mets, il/elle/on met, nous mettons, vous mettez, ils/elles mettent. The singular forms (je, tu, il/elle/on) drop the double 't', but the plural forms keep it. Common uses include mettre un manteau (to put on a coat), mettre la table (to set the table), and mettre du temps (to take time).

advanced.title: Mettre — Full Conjugation, Compounds & Common Expressions
advanced.explanation: Mettre (to put/to put on) is an irregular verb with doubling in plural forms. Full conjugation: je mets, tu mets, il/elle/on met, nous mettons, vous mettez, ils/elles mettent. The pattern shows singular forms dropping the double 't' and plural forms retaining it. Related verbs following the same pattern include permettre (to allow), promettre (to promise), remettre (to hand in/put back), soumettre (to submit), and transmettre (to transmit). Common expressions: mettre un manteau (to put on a coat), mettre la table (to set the table), mettre du temps (to take time), mettre en place (to set up), mettre fin (to end).

standard.scenario: Describe what you usually put on before leaving the house.
standard.modelAnswer: Je mets mon sac à main et mes lunettes. Et puis je mets un parapluie si c'est la pluie. Finalement je prends mon portefeuille et je suis prêt! Et toi, qu'est-ce que tu mets?
standard.modelAnswerExplanation: This response describes a logical sequence of putting on accessories, checks weather conditions, and ends by asking the other person.
standard.tip: Use 'Je mets...' and 'Et puis...' to describe a sequence. Always include 'Et toi?' to engage the other person in conversation.

advanced.scenario: Describe what you usually put on before leaving the house and ask someone about their routine.
keyPhrases: Et toi, qu'est-ce que tu mets?
advanced.modelAnswer: Je mets toujours mes lunettes et une cravate pour le travail. J'aime mettre mon collier en argent aussi. Avant de partir, je mets mon sac à main et je n'oublie pas mon portefeuille. Et je prends un parapluie si c'est nécessaire. Et toi, qu'est-ce que tu mets avant de sortir?
advanced.modelAnswerExplanation: This response includes personal preferences, describes a logical routine, and provides context with expressions like 'before leaving' and 'if necessary'.
advanced.tip: Use 'Je mets toujours...' and 'J'aime mettre...' to express preferences. Include time expressions like 'Avant de partir' for context. Ask 'Et toi...' to continue the conversation.
